text: An About screen in the main menu: the mark, what Tuppu means, the version, the licence — and Android's update check moves there from Settings

Landed in 014d2f2. About is last before Log out in both menus (web /about, Android Routes.ABOUT with Icons.Default.Info): the mark at 72 over "Tuppu", the tagline in nine locales, "Version X" (Android from packageManager, web from the app-version meta tag it never showed before, empty rather than crashing when absent), the licence line at the bottom. Android-only Updates block moved from Settings unchanged, the T-149 check-on-open now fires on About; UpdateViewModel took over UpdatePrefsStore so the wiring moved rather than duplicated. settings_version became about_version with its first web twin; settings_updates/auto_update_check* renamed to about_*. 13 new assertions, all mutation-checked. Gate green on main: server 504, web 417, Android.
